title: The Slow Interior
author: Astrid Voss
blurb: Ulyana Voss, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
